- Local PGLite storage and conservative keyword search.
- No API keys, embeddings, reranking, or paid enrichment.
- Automatic saving and transcript archiving off.
- No scheduled jobs, background services, or automatic upgrades.

Verified memory persistence, exact keyword retrieval, and MCP tool discovery/recall. Temporary test data was withdrawn afterward.

Live Gateway access remains unverified because the probe was unreachable, and the optional per-turn hook hit a packaging incompatibility. A tested local CLI fallback is configured, so the brain is usable without that hook.
